task_instance: Prepare a month-end (September 2026) journal entry for prepaid expense amortization across three sample prepaid items (insurance, software subscription, rent), from a source amortization schedule, following the skill's typical entry structure (debit expense / credit prepaid asset), calculating monthly amounts, assembling all required supporting documentation (memo, calculation support, source docs, period, preparer, reversal indicator, approval routing), and verifying the entry against the skill's review checklist (balanced debits/credits, no duplicates, well-formed lines).
evidence: Created prepaid_schedule.csv (3 sample prepaid items: insurance, software, rent) in the work directory. Wrote build_je.py which reads the schedule, computes straight-line monthly amortization for each item in the September 2026 period, and generates journal_entry.json with 6 JE lines (3 debit/3 credit pairs) plus calculation_support, supporting_documents, period, preparer, and reversal fields. Ran `python3 build_je.py` -> output: 'Lines generated: 3 / Total debits: 8500.0 / Total credits: 8500.0 / Balanced: True'. Wrote verify_je.py which programmatically checks the entry against the skill's Review Checklist (debits=credits, well-formed lines, no duplicate lines, memo/calc-support/source-docs/period/preparer/reversal-indicator all present). Ran `python3 verify_je.py` -> all 10 checks returned true, 'ALL CHECKS PASS: True'. Produced the final human-readable deliverable JE-2026-09-PREPAID-001.md, a complete journal entry memo with the entry table (debits=credits=$8,500.00), calculation support, source documents, reversal indicator, approval routing per the skill's approval matrix, and a filled-out review checklist per SKILL.md. All work stayed local (CSV/Python/Markdown), no MCP/connector or network calls were needed since the skill is a self-contained accounting knowledge/reference skill. Files produced: prepaid_schedule.csv, build_je.py, journal_entry.json, verify_je.py, JE-2026-09-PREPAID-001.md, result.json.
